newsitem.title: USA: Polycom to make two Lucent phones.
newsitem.headline: Polycom to make two Lucent phones.

text.p: Polycom Inc and Lucent Technologies Inc on Monday said two new business phones made by Polycom will be sold with the Lucent brand name under a three-year, original equipment manufacturer agreement.

Polycom will make versions of the SoundStation conference phone and the SoundPoint desktop conference phone, which interface directly with Lucent Technologies' Definity Enterprise Communications Server telephone sets.
Another version of the Lucent-branded SoundPoint phone will connect directly to analog phone sets.
Polycom shares were up 3/4 at 6 by mid-afternoon.
